sessions.title: AeT HEART-RATE DRIFT TEST #1 (treadmill, 3%)
sessions.key_cue: Uphill Athlete protocol. SETUP: treadmill at 3% (same machine and grade every test), CHEST STRAP (wet the contacts), fan on, cool room, same time of day and same pre-test meal as test #1, no caffeine in the 3 h before, after a rest day. WARM-UP 15 min: walk, then build speed until HR sits stable for 2-3 min at the STARTING HR. STARTING HR: test #1 = 145 bpm (between your race-validated ~136-150 band and the 149 working cap). Retests start at the last measured AeT. LAP. TEST 60 min at ONE locked speed and grade - do not touch the controls. LAP at 30:00 and at 60:00. COOL-DOWN 10 min easy. RESULT = avg HR 2nd half / avg HR 1st half - 1. <3.5% = your AeT is higher: retest +5 bpm. 3.5-5.0% = AeT = your starting HR. >5% = started above AeT: retest -5 bpm. GATE: AeT >= 152 (within 10% of LTHR 168) -> no aerobic deficiency; Z3 sessions switch on. Below 152 -> Z1-2 only, retest in 4-6 weeks. FIT to the Drive inbox the same day.
sessions.notes: Intensity: Test. The hr_cap_bpm here is only the provisional alert; the starting HR in the cue governs. Treadmill incline is NOT counted in elevation_gain_ft (no matching descent, no eccentric load). The result re-anchors EVERY AeT-referenced cap in this plan by patch revision (hr_anchor field). THE GATE for the whole cycle: it decides whether and when Z3 enters the plan, and it resets every easy-day ceiling. If the result is inconclusive (<3.5% or >5%), the retest takes Tuesday 10/20's slot.

sessions.title: AeT HEART-RATE DRIFT TEST #2 (treadmill, 3%)
sessions.key_cue: Uphill Athlete protocol. SETUP: treadmill at 3% (same machine and grade every test), CHEST STRAP (wet the contacts), fan on, COOL room (test #1 was run warm), same time of day and same pre-test meal as test #1, no caffeine in the 3 h before, after a rest day. WARM-UP 15 min: walk, then build speed until HR sits stable for 2-3 min at the STARTING HR. STARTING HR: 147 bpm (rev 2.2 - test #1 on 10/13 settled at 152 and drifted 5.2%, so AeT < 152; 152 - 5 = 147). STABILIZATION RULE: the test starts at the first lap press after HR has held within +/-2 bpm of the starting HR for 3 full minutes; if HR is still rising, drop the belt 0.1-0.2 mph and wait again; if not stable by 15:00, extend the warm-up rather than shorten the test. Retests after this start at the last measured AeT. LAP. TEST 60 min at ONE locked speed and grade - do not touch the controls. LAP at 30:00 and at 60:00. COOL-DOWN 10 min easy. RESULT = avg HR 2nd half / avg HR 1st half - 1. <3.5% = your AeT is higher: retest +5 bpm. 3.5-5.0% = AeT = your starting HR. >5% = started above AeT: retest -5 bpm. GATE: AeT >= 152 (within 10% of LTHR 168) -> no aerobic deficiency; Z3 sessions switch on. Below 152 -> Z1-2 only, retest in 4-6 weeks. FIT to the Drive inbox the same day.

The result re-anchors EVERY AeT-referenced cap in this plan by patch revision (hr_anchor field). Retest #2, 6 weeks after #1. Test #1 bounded AeT below 152 (no retest on 10/20 - athlete decision 10/13: the gate outcome cannot change in a week). Start at 147.
